# Project Management and Editorial Management

## Project and institutional relations coordinator

*FOVISEE and Weatherizers Without Borders (WWB) (Apr. 2025 – Sept. 2025)*

-   Coordinated initiatives on fair and sustainable housing, connecting technical teams, civil society organizations, universities, and municipal authorities.

-   Organized meetings, workshops, and presentations: outreach, logistics, agendas, minutes, and follow-up on agreements.

-   Managed project documentation (timelines, budgets, and reports for funders and partners).

-   Provided executive support: prioritization, planning, and monitoring of activities in high-demand contexts.

-   Managed multidisciplinary teams and coordinated with international partners; co-designed applied training programs (certificate programs/workshops).

## Editorial management

### **Editorial Assistant — Revista Gioja (UBA Law School)** (2023 – present)

-   Liaison with authors, reviewers, and the editorial team; coordinated with the technical team.

-   Managed the editorial calendar: deadline tracking, reminders, and follow-up throughout the review/publication process.

-   Systematized information and documentation in shared databases, ensuring traceability and an orderly workflow.

### **Editorial Secretary — Revista SAAP** (2017 – 2019)

-   Coordinated the article review process (submission, reminders, and recording editorial decisions).

-   Served as editorial secretary to meet publication schedules and strengthen institutional communication.
